title: Compare 12- and 18-Pack Egg Prices
description: At the example prices of $4.80 for 12 and $6.75 for 18, the dozen costs $1.95 less at checkout when you need 12 eggs. The 18-pack costs 37.5 cents per egg versus 40 cents for the dozen. Change the prices and how many eggs you need.
